source: Actual minified Practice after reaching Orchard on action 3. Shows the temporary Sloe landing, outward trip, timely return and final rescue on the clear-steps-first strategy, with normal motion. All earlier actions were played in the same session. No added audio, cut, overlays or retiming.
frameTiming: All delivered frames in timestamp order; real intervals retained. Native browser capture stalls remain. No cuts, retiming, overlays or interpolated frames.

audio.alignment: Runtime recorder aligned to first native image. Original in-game levels preserved; AAC compression, no gain adjustment.
audio.source: MediaRecorder receives a parallel feed from the actual output node connected to the browser destination, at its original gain. No test tone or second AudioContext.
